descriptor: Spreadsheet software with a public changelog

voice.summary: Gridwork writes release notes the way a good engineer would explain them to a teammate: what changed, why it matters, and what to do about it. It is concise, specific and unembarrassed by bug fixes.
dos: Start each entry with the user's benefit
Mark breaking changes clearly and say how to migrate
Use version numbers and dates exactly
donts: Do not hide fixes under 'general improvements'
Do not use marketing adjectives in release notes
Do not announce features that are not shipped

taglines: What changed in Gridwork this week
boilerplate: Gridwork is a spreadsheet and data tool for teams, and publishes a plain-spoken changelog covering every new feature, improvement and fix.

microcopy.success: Subscribed. Release notes will arrive in your inbox.

microcopy.empty: No releases match this filter. Try another tag.

logo.note: A simple grid is both the product and the structure of the changelog.
